leads.title: Benin Penal Code, new Code in force since 2018 - Article 545
leads.documents: Legal status of same-sex sexual activity; establishes greater penalties for indecent or unnatural act with a minor of the same sex, with equal age of consent regardless of sex; basis for claim same-sex acts legal between consenting adults
leads.detail: Article 545 of the new Penal Code in force since 2018

leads.title: Benin old Penal Code - Article 331 and 1947 amendment to Penal Code of 1877
leads.documents: Historical criminalization regime; set age of consent for same-sex relations at 21 and punished indecent act or act against nature with minor of same sex under 21 with 6 months to 3 years and fine 200 to 50,000 francs
leads.detail: article 331 of the old Penal Code; 1947 amendment to the Penal Code of 1877 fixing general age limit of 13 but penalizing same-sex acts under 21

leads.title: Benin draft Penal Code October 2008 - SECTION IV Articles 542, 543, 545
leads.documents: Proposed moral offenses law not yet voted; includes no reference to punishment for same-sex relations between consenting adults in private, but indecent-act provision noted as used to prosecute same-sex conduct
leads.detail: draft penal code from October 2008, SECTION IV: MORAL OFFENSES, Article 542, Article 543, Article 545

leads.title: Benin Children's Code, Law 2015-08 - Articles 96 and 104(d)
leads.documents: Adoption rights exclusion; full national adoption by married couples/single person, but foreign couple wishing to adopt child with Beninese nationality must not be homosexual under Criteria for Admission of an International Adopter
leads.detail: Article 96 of the Children's Code of Benin (Law 2015-08); Article 104(d)

leads.title: Benin Law No. 2017-20 on the Digital Code (2017) - Articles 394 and 552
leads.documents: Limited protections based on sexual orientation/sex life; Article 394 prohibits processing personal data revealing sex life or sexual orientation; Article 552 punishes incitement to hatred/violence based on sexual orientation via electronic network with 1 year imprisonment and 5,000,000 CFA fine
leads.detail: Article 394 on Sensitive Data of Law No. 2017-20 on the Digital Code; Article 552 on Incitement to hatred and violence of Law No. 2017-20

leads.title: Benin Law No. 2011-26 on Prevention and Suppression of Violence Against Women (2012) - Article 23
leads.documents: Labor-rights protection covering real or perceived sexuality; requires business leaders to prevent/punish sexual/sexist remarks or behavior based on sex or real or perceived sexuality infringing rights/dignity of women or girls
leads.detail: Article 23 of Law No. 2011-26 on the Prevention and Suppression of Violence Against Women (2012), Chapter II on Labor Rights

leads.title: Benin Personal Data Protection Law (2009) - Article 6
leads.documents: Prohibits collecting/processing personal data revealing health and sexual life without express consent; cited as limited protection related to sexual orientation
leads.detail: Article 6 of the Personal Data Protection Law (2009)

leads.title: Constitution of Benin - Article 36
leads.documents: General non-discrimination and tolerance machinery; duty to respect kin without discrimination and maintain relations permitting safeguarding of respect, dialogue and reciprocal tolerance

leads.title: U.S. Department of State 2023 Human Rights Report on Benin
leads.documents: Enforcement/living conditions; found LGBTQI+ community especially outside major urban areas faced hostility, and discrimination against LGBTQI+ persons was common
leads.detail: U.S. Department of State's 2023 Human Rights Report

leads.title: UN Human Rights Council Universal Periodic Review of Benin - 2008, 2012 and 2023 cycles; Benin Human Rights Commission reporting
leads.documents: Government enforcement stance and rights machinery; 2008 statement that homosexuality phenomenon marginal and no criminal ruling ever rendered; 2012 rejection of LGBTQ recommendations and 4 March 2013 meeting with French ambassador/Minister of Justice; 2023 acceptance of 2 of 15 recommendations including investigating/prosecuting anti-LGBTQ violence and combatting HIV stigma; Commission concerns about arbitrary detention, physical/sexual violence and degrading treatment
leads.detail: 2008 UNHRC Universal Periodic Review response; 4 March 2013 meeting on 2012 UNHRC UPR; 2023 Universal Periodic Review; Benin Human Rights commission report
